FAQ

Stella questions, answered.

What is Stella?

Stella is an AI calling agent and AI receptionist for businesses in Dubai and worldwide. It answers inbound calls, books appointments, qualifies leads and calls new web and ad leads back within seconds.

Does Stella sound like a robot?

No. Stella uses natural Arabic and English voices and understands normal conversation, including interruptions and follow-up questions.

Can I keep my existing phone number?

Yes. You can forward your existing number to Stella, for all calls or only missed and after-hours calls, or we can set up a new virtual number.

Can Stella transfer a call to my team?

Yes. Stella can transfer the caller to a team member when a human is needed, and always sends a summary of what was said.

How are call minutes counted?

Each plan includes a number of call minutes per month. Extra minutes are charged per minute at the rate shown for your plan.

Will callers know they are talking to AI?

Stella introduces itself as your AI assistant. Callers can ask for a human at any time.

How long does setup take?

Setup starts within 24 hours of your kickoff call, and we agree the go-live date with you on that call. This includes voice, script and phone number setup.

How much does Stella cost?

Inbound plans include call minutes and outbound plans include calling hours, all at fixed monthly prices shown on this page. Extra minutes are AED 1.20 each. Annual plans save 15%, with the setup fee fully waived on Starter and 50% off on Growth, Scale and Enterprise. Enterprise and Custom are quoted.
